describe.connecting: Whether the socket is currently connecting.
describe.pending: Whether the socket has not yet connected.
describe.timeout: The timeout in milliseconds, or `undefined` if no timeout is set.
describe.readyState: The current state of the socket. Either `'open'` or `'opening'`.
describe.localAddress: The local IP address of the socket, if connected.
describe.localFamily: The local IP family (`'IPv4'` or `'IPv6'`), if connected.
describe.localPort: The local port of the socket, if connected.
describe.remoteAddress: The remote IP address of the socket, if connected.
describe.remoteFamily: The remote IP family (`'IPv4'` or `'IPv6'`), if connected.
describe.remotePort: The remote port of the socket, if connected.
describe.connect: Connect the socket to `port` on `host`. If `host` is not provided, it defaults to `'localhost'`. `onconnect` is called when the connection is established.
describe.setKeepAlive: Enable or disable keep-alive. `delay` is the initial delay in milliseconds before the first keep-alive probe is sent.
describe.setNoDelay: Enable or disable Nagle's algorithm. When `enable` is `true` (the default), data is sent immediately without buffering.
describe.setTimeout: Set a timeout in milliseconds. When the socket is idle for `ms` milliseconds, a `timeout` event is emitted. Pass `0` to disable the timeout.
describe.ref: Ref the socket, preventing the process from exiting.
describe.unref: Unref the socket, allowing the process to exit.
describe.createServer: Create a new TCP server. `server` extends <https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-events>.
describe.listen: Start listening for connections on `port` and `host`. If `port` is `0`, an available port is assigned. If `host` is not provided, it defaults to `'localhost'`. `backlog` defaults to `511`.
describe.close: Close the server. No new connections will be accepted. The server emits `close` after all existing connections have ended.
describe.createConnection: Create a new socket and connect it to `port` on `host`. Shorthand for `new tcp.Socket(options).connect(port, host, options, onconnect)`.
describe.isIP: Returns `4` if `host` is an IPv4 address, `6` if it is an IPv6 address, or `0` otherwise.
describe.isIPv4: Returns `true` if `host` is an IPv4 address.
describe.isIPv6: Returns `true` if `host` is an IPv6 address.
